title: [DEV] AAPSclient misses downloads
symptom: AAPSclient misses downloads: data is in NS, but TBR won't download. Missing data won't backfill, even after force closing AAPSclient, deleting cache and restarting NSClient.
fix: On AAPS client, reset db, select NSCv3 tab and from menu do full sync. After full sync missing data is there.
evidence_quote: on AAPS client - reset db - select NSCv3 tab and from menu do full sync
